title: Trace a write until search can prove it is visible
description: Inject retries and indexing pressure, then compare mutation identity and read-after-write policies. Watch accepted writes diverge from searchable state when the indexing checkpoint falls behind.

mutations.label: Insert a new chunk
mutations.detail: The client expects a stable ID and must know when the new evidence becomes searchable.
mutations.risk: Duplicate delivery can create multiple records for one source chunk.

mutations.label: Replace an embedding
mutations.detail: A newer source version must supersede old text, metadata, and vector together.
mutations.risk: An older retry can overwrite a newer embedding when versions are not compared.

mutations.label: Delete revoked evidence
mutations.detail: A tombstone must stop retrieval before background compaction removes physical data.
mutations.risk: A delayed upsert can resurrect content after an unversioned delete.

contracts.label: Request-shaped writes
contracts.detail: Generate identity at delivery time and apply every retry as a new mutation.

contracts.label: Versioned idempotent writes
contracts.detail: Derive a stable point ID, compare source versions, and preserve delete tombstones.

readPolicies.label: Read immediately
readPolicies.detail: Query the serving index without waiting for the write checkpoint.

readPolicies.label: Wait for checkpoint
readPolicies.detail: Carry the acknowledged write sequence and wait until the serving index reaches it.

readPolicies.label: Read through an overlay
readPolicies.detail: Merge a bounded transactional change set with search results while indexing catches up.
